title: Volume / channels
description: Adjust gain, mute either channel or fold audio to mono.

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Region in
inputs.description: A region (the joins of a loop) to process instead of audio. The result stays a region: it never reaches an audio input, only a region-merge block turns it back into audio.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Loop seam
outputs.description: The processed region. Connect it to another effect or to a region-merge block.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.doc: Output gain, from -60 to +48 dB (a very quiet recording may need more than +12). Positive gain can clip.

parameters.name: left_gain
parameters.doc: Left output gain, applied after mono and common gain.

parameters.name: right_gain
parameters.doc: Right output gain, applied after mono and common gain.

parameters.name: linked
parameters.doc: Move channel faders together while preserving their gain difference. Does not change audio by itself.

parameters.name: left
parameters.doc: Off silences the left output channel.

parameters.name: right
parameters.doc: Off silences the right output channel.

parameters.name: mono
parameters.doc: Average left and right before applying channel mutes.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
